artworks.title: Knight and the Servant
artworks.description: In the image, there are two figures depicted. On the left is a knight in full armor riding a horse adorned with detailed attire. The knight's face is covered by a helmet with plumes. On the right is a person standing on foot, leaning forward with a spear. This individual has short hair and is wearing a padded garment with fitted pants. The background shows a lush forest with dense foliage.

artworks.title: Baptism in Jordan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a baptism scene. The image shows a figure kneeling in water while another figure pours water over their head. There are angelic beings with large wings surrounding the scene, and a divine presence appears in the clouds above. The background includes elements like trees and flowing water. The drawing is detailed with delicate line work, capturing human expressions and textures of nature. The composition is balanced with a heavenly radiance from the divine figure in the clouds, highlighted by the symmetry and peaceful arrangement of the celestial beings.

artworks.title: Pyrgoteles
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing beside a platform in a natural setting with cloudy skies. The figure is nude with muscular detailing and holds a staff with a sign that reads "PVRGOTELES." In front of the figure is an architecturally styled platform or altar, and the background features tall plants, possibly reeds. The sky is depicted with swirling clouds in contrasting shades. The overall composition conveys a classical or mythological theme, using strong lines and hatching to show textures and depths in the scene.

artworks.title: Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people gathered around a table for a meal. The scene shows individuals sitting around an oval table, which is decorated with simple food items and cups. The color palette is modest, with yellows, blues, and earthy tones. Each figure wears a robe and many are depicted with a circular halo above their heads. The figures have elongated features and closed eyes. The background features a curved architectural element, possibly an arch or a window, framing the gathering. The style resembles a medieval or early Renaissance woodcut illustration, reminiscent of religious art from that period.

artworks.title: Mary Magdalen Washing Feet of Christ
artworks.description: This is a print of a group of people seated at a dining table, with others standing nearby and watching them. In the front, a woman with long hair partially covered by a shawl is kneeling, facing the left, her face near the foot of a seated man. There is a bucket on the ground next to her. The table behind her is covered with various plates, cups, and food. More men are seated around the table, with a group of men standing on the right, observing the scene. The people all wear robes and different head coverings, and many of them, including the woman, have halos behind their head. The background features a window on the left with more people visible through it, and on the right an opening shows a person sitting among leafy vines.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a central figure and a cross in the background. The drawing features a central, emaciated figure draped across the lap of a seated figure. Both figures are rendered in strong lines characteristic of woodcuts, with emphasis on folds of fabric and anatomical details. The cross in the background has a draped cloth, and a circular form near the central figure's head. Surrounding elements include a thorny crown and barren tree branches.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows Standing
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 29.9 x 22.7 cm (11 3/4 x 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his arms outstretched, looking downward. He has a beard, long hair, and wears a loincloth. A crown of thorns adorns his head, with rays emanating from it. He holds a staff or spear in his left hand. In the background, a rooster stands by a draped cloth on a wooden frame, with coins and dice scattered nearby. Hills or mountains and clouds with rain or beam lines are visible. The text "ECCE HOMO" is inscribed to the left.

artworks.title: Allegory - Religious Frivolity
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration featuring a group of robed figures in what seems to be a religious or medieval setting. The figures are shown from the waist up, with many facing towards the right side where an angelic figure is seated on a cloud, blowing a trumpet. The people have different hairstyles and various expressions. They are dressed in robes with intricate details, some with patterned collars or cuffs. One figure holds a string of beads. In the background, there is a cloudy sky, setting a divine tone. The line work in the image adds texture and emphasizes the historical and stylistic themes.

artworks.title: Page from Troianischen Kreig - Ausberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with text. The image features a detailed woodcut illustration depicting a scene from a classical story. The image shows a figure sitting on a chair or throne on the left side. They are adorned in regal attire. In the center, a figure approaches with a sword. To the right, creatures or armored figures appear to be emerging from a cluster, holding shields and helmets. The scene is surrounded by decorative elements, and the drawing is framed above and below by text in a stylized script, recounting a narrative related to Ulysses. The details and layout suggest a story from ancient mythology.

artworks.title: Page from Geschlechter Buch - Ausberg
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one leg slightly bent, wearing ornate armor and holding a sword. He has a beard and his head is covered by a decorated helmet. Beside him is a large shield with detailed designs. Above his head is an inscription identifying him as Herr Hans Jacob Fugger, Burgermeister.

artworks.title: Ben Hawkin's Blacksmith Shop
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a large workbench and a grinder in front of two windows with a lattice design. The color palette is primarily brown and cream, creating a sketch-like effect. The workbench occupies the lower central part of the image, with tools and equipment visible. Shelves and hanging implements are on the left wall, while beams and a ceiling lamp frame the scene in the upper part of the sketch.

artworks.title: The Death of General Wolf
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people. Some stand, while one person lies on the ground in the center. Surrounding individuals wear 18th-century military attire, and hats are scattered around them. A large flag is in the background, with soldiers and battling troops visible. Additional figures are present, including one with a band around their head and another dressed differently, possibly representing an indigenous person. The scene implies a battlefield setting with soldiers and battle formations in the background.

artworks.title: William Penn's Treaty with the Indians
artworks.description: The drawing shows a gathering of figures in a woodsy outdoor setting. It features individuals dressed in attire suggestive of early colonial America engaged in a formal meeting or negotiation. On one side, individuals in elaborate feathered headdresses and traditional attire represent Native Americans. Opposite them, a group in 17th-century colonial clothing suggests a discussion between the two parties. In the background are colonial-style houses, tall trees, and ships anchored by the shoreline. The drawing depicts details of clothing, expressions, and setting, evoking a sense of historical formality and cultural interaction.

artworks.title: Large jug, the handle formed by a snake
artworks.description: The image features a tankard with a lid, decorated with floral and scroll patterns. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black linework on an off-white background. The tankard is centrally placed in the foreground, with the handle to the right and an ornate finial on the lid at the top.

artworks.title: Chalice with Head of a Warrior
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed goblet or chalice with ornate decorations and faces etched into its design. The goblet stands as the central and largest object. The color palette consists of black and off-white. The goblet reaches from the base of the image to near the top, with human head designs on the left and right of its stem, and carved faces on its bowl. Beneath the goblet are "G" and "W" on either side along the lower section.

artworks.title: Goblet decorated with masque
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate cup design. The drawing features an intricately decorated cup with elaborate patterns and motifs. The upper part of the cup is adorned with curvilinear scrollwork and a central mask-like face with human features surrounded by symmetrical winged forms. The cup's stem and base continue the theme of ornamentation, featuring scrollwork and decorative elements reminiscent of Renaissance design. Below the cup are additional decorative elements, including two smaller mask motifs on either side and letters "G" and "W". This artwork's detailed style reflects the aesthetic sensibilities of its time, focusing on symmetrical and highly decorative patterns.

artworks.title: Goblet with base decorated with two large scallops
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative chalice design. The image features an intricately designed chalice with Baroque-style flourishes, acanthus leaves, and scrollwork. A face at the center merges with the decoration. Flanking the stem are two faces resembling cherubic or theatrical masks. The base is detailed with rich pattern work. The letters "G" and "W" are near the top of the base.

artworks.title: Goblet with lid surmounted by a Roman soldier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate goblet. The drawing depicts a highly detailed and intricately designed goblet with elaborate decorations. The goblet features a lid topped with a small sculptural figure holding a staff and shield, standing atop an ornate floral motif. The body of the goblet is adorned with swirling patterns and faces, one of which appears to be a cherubic or angelic visage. The stem of the goblet also showcases detailed floral and scrollwork designs, with additional small faces integrated. At the base of the goblet, there is a complex, symmetric pattern with scrolls and foliage. Two stylized masks with exaggerated features are illustrated on either side of the goblet.

artworks.title: Goblet with Putto on lid
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed goblet with an ornate design covering its entire surface in grayscale tones. A small figure holding a scroll is at the top of the goblet, positioned centrally on the lid. The goblet extends from the base to the figure, showcasing symmetrical decoration throughout.

artworks.title: Goblet with two Masques on lid
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate urn or goblet with intricate designs, including floral and vine motifs, face-like patterns, a lid, base, and handles. The color scheme is monochrome with black detailing on a cream or off-white background. The main object is in the center, with two smaller face designs labeled "G" on the left and "W" on the right.

artworks.title: Goblet decorated with a masque with open mouth
artworks.description: The image shows an intricately designed goblet with elaborate scrollwork and human-like faces, sitting on a pedestal with detailed carvings. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily black ink on beige paper background. Two highly detailed face-like designs are positioned on either side of the goblet stem, which is centrally placed on a decorative base.

artworks.title: Two small goblets superimposed in reverse
artworks.description: The image depicts intricate swirling lines and flowing curves forming abstract patterns within an elaborate goblet-like structure. The composition includes cherubic faces with wings integrated into the design. The symmetrical arrangement and embellishments, along with the abstract forms, create a resemblance to a decorative ornamental piece like a vase or a cup, showcasing the artistic style's intricacy and elegance.

artworks.title: Goblet, rim decorated with masque with  gaping mouth
artworks.description: The image features a large, ornate goblet with a lid, decorated with intricate patterns and motifs in a monochromatic color palette. The goblet is centered vertically in the image, with additional decorative elements such as a leafy finial on top. Below the main goblet are two symmetrical face designs on either side of its stem, which is inscribed with the letters "G W". The composition is surrounded by an unadorned border.

artworks.title: Goblet, rim decorated with masque and bouquet of fruit
artworks.description: The image shows an ornamental cup with intricate designs and patterns, including human-like faces, floral motifs, and cherubic faces. The cup is styled in black ink on a cream-colored background. Floral designs are on the sides, with mask-like faces on either side of the cup's stem.
